source: Original procedural foley model; no downloaded or recorded material. Applies to the 27 kinds below only: goblin_hurt uses external public-domain recordings and is documented separately in ../goblin_hurt/source.json

recipes.swing_light: cloth + narrow blade air shear + steel micro resonance
recipes.swing_back: backhand air shear + grip creak + trailing blade ring
recipes.swing_heavy: broadband air displacement + low pressure + grip snap
recipes.swing_air: open-air blade hiss + leather stretch + mid resonance
recipes.swing_upper: upward accelerating air column + blade-flex ring
recipes.dash: cloth rush + low boot scrape + air shear
recipes.dash_strike: fast air shear + heavy grip snap + sharp steel edge
recipes.light: damped flesh body + leather slap + blade edge scrape
recipes.heavy: low pressure impact + flesh tear + grit + damped blade modes
recipes.launch: dense body impact + high blade scrape + upward air release
recipes.metal_hit: steel plate modal vibration + bright impact grit + low contact body
recipes.guard: two steel blades contact + inharmonic high modes + hand/grip body
recipes.hurt: leather thud + broad body strike + expelled filtered air
recipes.step: boot sole on stone + leather fold + secondary heel contact
recipes.run_step: hard boot heel + sole compression + short leather contact
recipes.run_stop: boot friction on stone + cloth pull + heel settle
recipes.jump: boot push-off + cloth stretch + small air release
recipes.land: paired boot impact + low sole compression + stone grit + cloth settle
recipes.charge: reverse blade-air gather + muted steel partials + grip draw
recipes.draw_strike: instant steel release + fast broadband cut + low pressure impulse
recipes.rage: rough low air pressure + crackling ember impulses + damped steel
recipes.rage_strike: two blade shear layers + low impact pressure + gritty crackle
recipes.thrust: needle-like air shear + short steel tip ring + leather snap
recipes.death: monster breath collapse + body-to-floor thud + leather/grit fall
recipes.wave: three soft struck-metal warning intervals + low arena pulse
recipes.victory: four warm bell/modal intervals with natural overlapping decay
recipes.ui: quiet leather/mechanical interface click with damped metal overtone
